Maya: FYI found a handful of pilot accounts with duplicate owner rows after yesterday's connector backfill. example acct_0xB2 — two owner rows.
Jon: oof. can you run the quick query to surface them?
Maya: ran: SELECT account_id FROM owners GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(owner_id) > 1 LIMIT 200; gives 37 matches.
Rina: ok let's not spam CSMs. plan: pause scheduled backfill for 1h, run an idempotent merge script, tag affected accounts with 'owner-hygiene-review' and suppress health alerts for 48h.
Jon: agree. also queue a small healthscore recalculation for those 37 after merge.
Maya: Will run merge script now in dry-run, post results.
OpsBot: dry-run merge scheduled by Maya at 2026-03-22T11:30Z. estimated affected: 37.
Rina: once dry-run looks clean, we flip dry_run=false on playbook rule and notify CSMs with a short note. can someone draft the note?
Maya: draft: "Quick housekeeping: we merged duplicate owner rows created by recent connector activity. No action required; we've tagged your accounts for review and paused renewal nudges while we validate."
Jon: LGTM. Maya please post final success/failure here when done.
Maya: posting results in 10m.
